data.long_meaning: Gileem is a name of Arabic and Urdu origin meaning Joyful, Delightful, Beautiful. The name Gileem carries the meaning “Joyful, Delightful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Gileem usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, delightful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Gileem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Delightful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gileem total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gileem reflects a warm, joyful, and delightful personality. It is a name that evokes happiness and a positive outlook on life. In many Islamic cultures, the naming of a child is given careful thought and consideration, reflecting the family's hopes and dreams for the child's future. The name Gileem may be seen as a wish for the child to be a source of joy and happiness for their family and community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic traditions, the naming of a child is not only a matter of cultural significance, but also a spiritual one. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Give names to your children that are the names of righteous people." (Bukhari and Muslim). The name Gileem, meaning Beautiful, can be seen as a reminder of the inner beauty that every individual possesses and striving to develop, in accordance with the teachings of Islam. The name also reflects the belief that the true beauty of a person lies in their good character and actions, rather than just their physical appearance. Additionally, the name can inspire the person to strive towards being a source of beauty and joy in the lives of others.
